item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description:
What's new

  • English and Traditional Chinese:
    • TaskBoard now speaks English, Simplified Chinese (任务看板) and Traditional Chinese (任務看板). That covers menus, dialogs, dates, reminders and the app name.
    • It follows your system language by default.
    • To switch, use Settings → General, then relaunch from there.
  • Settings window (⌘,): language, default time and reminder for new due dates, how many backups to keep, data location, import/export, and update preferences.
  • Import & export:
    • Export a board to a .taskboard file with its lists, cards, labels and attachments. Find it in the board's gear menu, by right-clicking the sidebar, or with ⇧⌘E. Importing it adds a new board and never changes existing ones.
    • Export all data to move everything to another Mac. On import, choose Add as New Boards or Replace All Data. Replacing backs up your current data first and can be undone with ⌘Z.
    • Import with File → Import… (⇧⌘I), or double-click a .taskboard file.
  • Smoother list reordering: drag a whole list and the others slide aside to preview the new order. Release to place it; drop outside the board or press Esc to cancel.

Notes

  • The app file is now named TaskBoard.app. Finder shows it as 任务看板 or 任務看板 on Chinese systems. If you update from inside the app, your existing copy keeps its current file name.
  • Your boards keep their names. Only new boards and the welcome board use the selected language.

Install

  • Already on 1.3.0: use 任务看板 → 检查更新…, or wait for the automatic check.
  • New install, or 1.2.0 and earlier:
    1. Download TaskBoard-1.4.0.dmg below, open it, and drag TaskBoard into Applications.
    2. The first launch is blocked because the app isn't notarized by Apple. Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway, or run this in Terminal: 
      xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/TaskBoard.app"

Requirements: macOS 14 Sonoma or later. The DMG is a universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
What's new

  • Automatic updates: TaskBoard now updates itself.
    • It checks for new versions daily; you can also use 任务看板 → 检查更新….
    • Updates are signed, and the app verifies each one before installing.
  • Reorder lists by dragging: grab the ≡ handle or the list title and drop it before or after another list. A blue bar shows where it will land.
  • Markdown descriptions:
    • Card descriptions render headings, lists, task lists, bold, italic, code, links, quotes and code blocks.
    • Double-click the description, or click 编辑, to edit it.
  • Auto-archive: in a board's gear menu (看板设置), done cards can archive themselves 1, 3, 7 or 30 days after completion.
  • Smoother interface:
    • Cards and lists animate as they move, appear and disappear.
    • Drop targets open up space while you drag, and cards lift slightly on hover.
    • With Reduce Motion turned on, movement is replaced by simple fades.
  • Faster boards: images load in the background, and only cards that actually changed are redrawn.

Upgrading

This is the first version with the built-in updater. If you're on 1.2.0 or earlier, install it manually once: replace the app in Applications. Later versions will arrive inside the app.

Your data upgrades automatically, and auto-archive stays off until you turn it on.

Install

  1. Download TaskBoard-1.3.0.dmg below, open it, and drag 任务看板 into Applications.
  2. The app isn't notarized by Apple, so the first launch is blocked. To allow it:
    • Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
    • Alternatively, run this in Terminal: 
      xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/任务看板.app"

Requirements: macOS 14 Sonoma or later. The DMG is a universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
